package.name: whill_perception
package.description: Perception preprocessing for the WHILL chair. First node: patchworkpp_node, a wrapper around the BSD-2-Clause Patchwork++ ground segmentation C++ core (src/third_party/patchwork_plusplus/cpp/). Splits /velodyne_points into ground and non-ground clouds so downstream Nav2 obstacle_layer sees only the non-ground return. Written to keep the runtime stack permissive — upstream's ROS 2 wrapper declares GPL-3.0 in package.xml, which is why we do not use it directly.
